headlines.text: That Friday in 2023, El Hijo del Vikingo vs. Black Taurus went to battle over the AAA Mega Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.23 ? a real highlight of the night. It was the first title opportunity of Black Taurus's career. Vikingo survived a discus lariat and a fireman's-carry powerbomb from Taurus before finishing him with a 630 senton to retain the AAA Mega Championship.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when FTR & MJF didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.93 ? a strong outing.

That Friday in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. Rocky Romero went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: 2021 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Adam Cole and Orange Cassidy, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a match that delivered.
Back on this day in 2021, Ruby Soho vs. Nyla Rose met in a Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 5.86 ? part of that year's Holiday Bash '21 - Night 1.
2023 brought us this moment: The Kingdom vs. The Hardys met for the very first time on Rampage, rated 5.25.
